name: Cetaphil - Oily Cleanser Combination to Oily, Sensitive Skin
description:
A gentle gel to foam formula that removes excess oil, dirt, skin debris and light make-up. This cleanser deeply cleans and minimises pores without stripping skin of natural moisture.

Designed with a dermatologist-backed blend of Niacinamide (vitamin B3) and Panthenol (pro-vitamin B5) to preserve the natural skin barrier

Clinically proven to deep clean without leaving skin dry or tight

Dermatologist tested and clinically proven to be gentle on sensitive skin
